name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-tags
description: Quartz 5 tag engine: one dictionary of tag colours and icon ids, published per page on fileData, as static/cgcTags.json, and as one --cgc-tag-* custom property per tag. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: lightningcss is the parser Quartz reads CSS with, so a colour passes exactly when Quartz would read it as one, and the utilities slugify tags exactly as Quartz does. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Inlined into dist by build.mjs, or the build tools themselves: esbuild, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations, which writes the .d.ts beside each entry. Our libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-tags
quartz.description: The tag engine: one dictionary of tag colours and icon ids, published for other plugins to read. Draws nothing itself.
